description: This file defines a class 'Gdpr' within the Opencart system, specifically for the catalog's cron jobs related to GDPR functionalities. It extends a base controller class and contains a method 'index' that handles GDPR data processing, such as retrieving GDPR expiration records, updating their status, and deleting customers based on email matches.

classes.name: Gdpr
classes.description: Controller class for handling GDPR-related cron tasks within the Opencart catalog module.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method invoked by the cron system to process GDPR expiration and customer deletion logic. It loads necessary models, retrieves GDPR expiration entries, updates their status, and deletes the associated customer records based on email.
